annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paying to activate progressively more expensive Forsage positions while presenting the resulting income and profits as increasing and encouraging viewers to build a team. It gives a concrete participation strategy involving multiple positions, a stated ETH cost and gas funding, then directs viewers to continue with the person who shared the video. The communication is an earning solicitation centered on a tiered team structure rather than a warning or investigation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video ties income to activating positions in X3 and X4 matrices and explicitly recommends an optional team strategy intended to grow the participant's team faster. The evidence shows both a multi-level structure and an earnings relationship dependent on team participation, beyond a simple one-level referral.
